policy.retry: one identical retry per line ONLY when no audio came back (network error, non-200, zero bytes); never to improve a take

lines.direction: Say this warmly and confidently with a smile in your voice, calm and clear, unhurried, like a friendly expert guiding someone step by step:
lines.text: Welcome. Catch one bug on each page, and you will finish with a real bug report.
lines.caption_ar: أهلًا بك. اصطد خطأً واحدًا في كل صفحة، وستنتهي بتقرير أخطاء حقيقي.
lines.seconds_basis: estimate words/146*60; replaced by ffprobe after the one render

lines.direction: Say this warmly and confidently with a smile in your voice, calm and clear, unhurried, like a friendly expert guiding someone step by step:
lines.text: Level one. Open QA Wrap and press its main button to wake it. Then press the save button on this page.
lines.caption_ar: المستوى الأول. افتح QA Wrap واضغط زره الرئيسي لإيقاظه. ثم اضغط زر الحفظ في هذه الصفحة.
lines.seconds_basis: estimate words/146*60; replaced by ffprobe after the one render

lines.direction: Say this warmly and confidently with a smile in your voice, calm and clear, unhurried, like a friendly expert guiding someone step by step:
lines.text: Level two. Apply a coupon, and QA Wrap catches what breaks. If another failure is harmless, tell QA Wrap it is not a real bug.
lines.caption_ar: المستوى الثاني. طبّق قسيمة، وسيلتقط QA Wrap ما يتعطّل. وإن كان فشل آخر غير ضار، فأخبر QA Wrap أنه ليس علّة حقيقية.
lines.seconds_basis: estimate words/146*60; replaced by ffprobe after the one render

lines.direction: Say this warmly and confidently with a smile in your voice, calm and clear, unhurried, like a friendly expert guiding someone step by step:
lines.text: Level three. Press the next button. If nothing happens, type what you saw in the QA Wrap note box, and press Enter.
lines.caption_ar: المستوى الثالث. اضغط زر التالي. إن لم يحدث شيء، فاكتب ما رأيته في خانة الملاحظات في QA Wrap، ثم اضغط Enter.
lines.seconds_basis: estimate words/146*60; replaced by ffprobe after the one render

lines.direction: Say this warmly and confidently with a smile in your voice, calm and clear, unhurried, like a friendly expert guiding someone step by step:
lines.text: Level four. Does the order number fit its box? Take a screenshot with QA Wrap, then mark the spot on it.
lines.caption_ar: المستوى الرابع. هل يتسع رقم الطلب داخل مربعه؟ التقط لقطة شاشة بواسطة QA Wrap، ثم ضع علامة على الموضع.
lines.seconds_basis: estimate words/146*60; replaced by ffprobe after the one render

lines.direction: Say this warmly and confidently with a smile in your voice, calm and clear, unhurried, like a friendly expert guiding someone step by step:
lines.text: Level five. Press the pay button. Then stop QA Wrap, copy the report, and paste it here.
lines.caption_ar: المستوى الخامس. اضغط زر الدفع. ثم أوقف QA Wrap، وانسخ التقرير، والصقه هنا.
lines.seconds_basis: estimate words/146*60; replaced by ffprobe after the one render

lines.direction: Say this warmly and confidently with a smile in your voice, calm and clear, unhurried, like a friendly expert guiding someone step by step:
lines.text: Nice catch. That is exactly the kind of bug to note.
lines.caption_ar: صيدة جميلة. هذا بالضبط نوع الأخطاء الذي يستحق التدوين.
lines.seconds_basis: estimate words/146*60; replaced by ffprobe after the one render

lines.direction: Say this warmly and confidently with a smile in your voice, calm and clear, unhurried, like a friendly expert guiding someone step by step:
lines.text: Good evidence. Short and clear is all a report needs.
lines.caption_ar: دليل جيد. القصير الواضح هو كل ما يحتاجه التقرير.
lines.plays_when: first prove step done (once per run)
lines.seconds_basis: estimate words/146*60; replaced by ffprobe after the one render

lines.direction: Say this warmly and confidently with a smile in your voice, calm and clear, unhurried, like a friendly expert guiding someone step by step:
lines.text: Good rhythm so far. Keep noting what you see, it is the habit that matters.
lines.caption_ar: إيقاع جيد حتى الآن. واصل تدوين ما تراه، فهذه هي العادة المهمة.
lines.seconds_basis: estimate words/146*60; replaced by ffprobe after the one render

lines.direction: Say this warmly and confidently with a smile in your voice, calm and clear, unhurried, like a friendly expert guiding someone step by step:
lines.text: Not yet. Take your time, there is a hint if you want one.
lines.caption_ar: لم نصل بعد. خذ وقتك، وهناك تلميح إن أردته.
lines.plays_when: hint after 8 s idle (once per level)
lines.seconds_basis: estimate words/146*60; replaced by ffprobe after the one render

lines.direction: Say this warmly and confidently with a smile in your voice, calm and clear, unhurried, like a friendly expert guiding someone step by step:
lines.text: Well done. Notice the bug, note it, copy the report. That is the whole job, and it works on any site.
lines.caption_ar: أحسنت. لاحظ الخطأ، ودوّنه، وانسخ التقرير. هذه هي المهمة كلها، وتنجح على أي موقع.
